scientific_integrity: All stated identities and the global inverse theorem are analytically justified; exact-rational computations independently check polynomial expansions and examples. No independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean triangles and independent area-uniform point pairs only.
The forward pair-distance distribution and arbitrary moments have established earlier formulas.
The inverse stability exponent is optimal, but the displayed numerical constant is not claimed optimal.
The original Gates 1982 full manuscript was not available for complete historical-priority comparison.
title: Three even distance moments reconstruct triangles with sharp cube-root stability
